earn_rates.text: Receive 0.8% cash rebate (Spend HKD 125 = HKD 1 Cash Rebate) on all local food & beverage spending and overseas spending (excluding internet transactions and HKD transactions made outside Hong Kong).

benefits.text: Earn 1 VOYAGE Mile per HKD 4 spent in foreign currencies or per HKD 6 spent locally.

details.guest_policy_text: The complimentary visits are shared by the Principal Cardholder and/or Supplementary Cardholder(s) and/or your companion guest.

benefits.text: Get 4 shareable complimentary lounge visits to designated airport lounges worldwide every calendar year.

benefits.text: Simply pay for your outbound travel expenses departing from Hong Kong, such as purchasing flight tickets, with your Premier VOYAGE Card and enjoy complimentary personal accident insurance coverage of up to USD1 million during the travel period.
